import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
answers[44]['slots']['2']='ъ'
answers[44]['confidence']['2']='low'
answers[44]['note']='Slot 2: leftward top flag is faint and partly broken.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers:f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(items)==len(answers)
for r,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(answers))
print('Slot calls:',{k:c[k] for k in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
